receiver or upstream software must supply the observations and modelling terms. There is no

ambiguity resolution, RTK/PPP and multi-constellation bias states are separate extensions, not

The updated tools/ugts_handoff.py invokes the coupled proﬁle by default. It consumes the

30.1 Exact FP64 bit transport in the texture path
A CUDA linear texture resource uses an int2 channel. Each texel carries the 64 raw bits of one
double; the device reconstructs the value using the low and high 32-bit words. The read uses
an integer tex1Dfetch; there is no interpolation, normalized-coordinate lookup or conversion of
ranges into ﬂoat values. [H4][N10]
const int2 bits = tex1Dfetch<int2>(texture, integer_index);
const double value = __hiloint2double(bits.y, bits.x);
The global path reads the same double buﬀer directly. Both paths use the same solver and output
record. Equality of decoded inputs is a data-representation property; it does not guarantee a
texture speedup for this access pattern.
30.2 Ownership and publication
Device buﬀers and events use local ownership wrappers. A texture object is destroyed before
its backing buﬀer. Each launched epoch has one writer. The program checks CUDA allocation,
copies, launch and completion before publishing downloaded result ﬁles. A failed device call is
an error, not a CPU fallback labelled as a GPU success.
The ﬁrst chunk receives an untimed warmup. Device events measure subsequent kernel intervals
and their sum is reported. CSV parsing, allocations, texture construction, host packing, uploads,
downloads and the Python event adapter are outside that sum. A CPU loop interval and a full
application latency are therefore distinct quantities.
